annotations.title: Funeral Cost Planner and Your Rights

description: Use this when asked 'What does a funeral with burial or cremation cost, and what are my rights when I buy one?' or 'Help me add up the itemized prices a funeral home gave me and show what is still missing.' Returns FTC Funeral Rule rights first. Reference figures are NFDA 2023 national medians from an industry member survey, not local prices. Bundle cards apply only to services with viewing; direct services have no citable national bundle figure. The worksheet adds up the family's own itemized prices and keeps missing prices visible. Pure rules and Decimal money, no network or model. Web and MCP share the free daily allowance. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

prices.description: Your own itemized prices in dollars. Omit an unknown price; 0 means not buying or included elsewhere.

basic_services.description: Funeral director and staff basic services; always applies.

cash_advances.description: Cash advances (death certificates, obituary notices, flowers, clergy, and similar); always applies.

casket.description: Casket (bought here or elsewhere); requires burial or cremation with service viewing_ceremony (purchase or rental).

ceremony_facilities.description: Facilities and staff for the ceremony; requires service viewing_ceremony.

embalming_preparation.description: Embalming or other preparation; requires service viewing_ceremony.

opening_closing.description: Opening and closing the grave or niche; always applies.

plot.description: Cemetery plot or interment space; always applies.

transfer.description: Transfer of remains to the funeral home; always applies.

vault.description: Outer burial container (vault or liner); requires burial with vault yes or unknown.

vehicles.description: Hearse and other vehicles; requires burial or service viewing_ceremony.

viewing_facilities.description: Facilities and staff for viewing; requires service viewing_ceremony.

service.description: Direct means immediate burial or direct cremation, without viewing.
